goal:
Create src/components/Body3DModel/woundSprites.ts and src/components/Body3DModel/woundSprites.test.ts.

PURPOSE: procedural canvas art for wound decals that will be composited onto a patient skin texture atlas. Each function draws a realistic-looking wound onto a canvas 2D context at a given position/size and returns nothing (draws in place).

EXPORT: export type WoundKind = 'surgical-incision' | 'infected-incision' | 'laceration' | 'abrasion' | 'bruise' | 'burn';

EXPORT: export function drawWound(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, kind: WoundKind, cx: number, cy: number, sizePx: number, rotationRad?: number): void

DRAWING SPECS (layered translucent shapes — NO solid cartoon outlines; build up soft organic irregularity with multiple strokes/fills at varying alpha):
- surgical-incision: a thin straight dark-red line (2-4% of sizePx wide) with small perpendicular suture marks every ~12% of length in darker tone, faint pink halo (radial gradient, alpha ~0.25) around it.
- infected-incision: same incision but halo is wider and angrier (red-orange, alpha ~0.4), with a few small yellowish exudate spots (alpha ~0.5) along the line.
- laceration: an irregular jagged polyline (5-8 segments with random-ish perpendicular jitter derived from a seeded pattern — use a deterministic pseudo-random from position so tests are stable: e.g. seed = cx*31+cy*17), dark red core, thin darker edge, mild pink halo.
- abrasion: an elliptical patch of many small overlapping dots/scratches (deterministic pattern), red-brown, alpha 0.15-0.35, no sharp border.
- bruise: concentric soft radial gradients — deep purple center, blue-purple mid, yellow-green outer ring, overall alpha ~0.45, elliptical.
- burn: irregular patch with deep red center, blistered lighter-pink rim (small circles along the border), thin white/pale edge highlights, alpha layered.
All drawing must respect rotationRad (rotate around cx,cy; default 0), use ctx.save()/restore(), and touch ONLY the region within ~1.6*sizePx of (cx,cy).

TESTS (vitest, node environment — NO jsdom; construct the canvas via the 'canvas'... STOP: no canvas package exists in node. Instead structure tests WITHOUT real rendering: mock a minimal CanvasRenderingContext2D as a recording stub (a Proxy or object with jest-style arrays capturing method calls: save, restore, beginPath, arc, ellipse, lineTo, moveTo, fill, stroke, createRadialGradient (return {addColorStop: () => {}}), fillRect, rotate, translate, setTransform etc. plus settable properties fillStyle/strokeStyle/globalAlpha/lineWidth). Tests assert for each of the 6 kinds: drawWound completes without throwing; save() and restore() call counts are equal; at least 5 drawing operations (fill/stroke/arc/ellipse/lineTo) were recorded; when rotationRad is nonzero, rotate() was called; drawing calls stay within bounds (every arc/ellipse center x,y within 1.6*sizePx of cx,cy — check recorded args). Also: same inputs produce identical call sequences twice in a row (determinism).
At least 10 test cases total.
verify: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npx vitest run src/components/Body3DModel/woundSprites.test.ts
